sentences.text: Chelyoposuchus is classified as a reptile.
It belongs to the family Henodontidae.
Fossil remains were discovered in the Baerecke-Limpricht clay pit near Halberstadt in Germany.
The holotype specimen — the specific fossil the species is based on — was collected by Otto Jaekel between 1909 and 1913 from the Knollenmergel Member of the Trossingen Formation.
The type species Chelyoposuchus crassisquamatus was formally named in 1939.
This animal lived during the late Rhaetian stage, approximately 205.6 to 201.6 million years ago.
